name: STS2 LAN Co-op
author: STS2 LAN Co-op contributors
description: One DLL for STS2 v0.107.1/v0.111.0. Same game and mod version required. Preserves Ritsu sidecar framing and protects retired lobby callbacks. Short-lived sync connections separate downloads from local packaging. Per-mod folders and Workshop organization. Gameplay mods and dependencies must match; Android installation is manual.
